Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Information related to an identification, eg, party identification or account identification.

SafekeepingAccount.name: Safekeeping Account
SafekeepingAccount.definition: Account to or from which a securities entry is made.

CashAccount.name: Cash Account
CashAccount.definition: Account to or from which a cash entry is made.

ProcessingIdentification.name: Processing Identification
ProcessingIdentification.definition: Unambiguous identification of the transaction for the party identified.

CountryOfResidence.name: Country Of Residence
CountryOfResidence.definition: Country in which a person resides (the place of a person's home). In the case of a company, it is the country from which the affairs of that company are directed.

AdditionalInformation.name: Additional Information
AdditionalInformation.definition: Provides additional information regarding the party.

IdentificationUsageRule.definition: The presence of Identification and/or CountryOfResidence is mandatory.
